summary: GRI 206 covers anti-competitive behavior, including anti-trust and monopoly practices. It addresses actions that can result in collusion with competitors or barriers to entry, intended to limit market competition.

questions.text: How does the organization manage anti-competitive behavior as a material topic (GRI 3-3)?
questions.hint: Describe how the organization manages the topic and its related impacts, as required by Disclosure 3-3 in GRI 3: Material Topics 2021.

questions.text: What legal actions were pending or completed regarding anti-competitive behavior, anti-trust and monopoly practices?
questions.hint: a. Number of legal actions pending or completed in the period regarding anti-competitive behavior and violations of anti-trust and monopoly legislation in which the organization was identified as a participant. b. Main outcomes of completed actions, including decisions or judgements.
